command.name: security key-manager keystore upgrade
command.description: This command upgrades the keystore to the SVM-KEK architecture.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver to upgrade.

example.p: The following example upgrades all Vservers to the SVM-KEK architecture.
The following example upgrades a specific Vserver to the SVM-KEK architecture.
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager keystore upgrade -vserver vsTest
